description.message: Read, search and export Overleaf review comments and their replies from the project you have open.

privacy_note.message: Reads comments, replies, author names and dates in the open Overleaf project. Selected source text is optional. The extension keeps this data on your device and never changes the project.

first_read.message: Click Read project comments to allow this read-only access when you open the extension.

diagnostics.message: Read diagnostics (no comment text, names or project ID)

open_editor.message: Open a project editor in Overleaf, then click the extension from that tab.

missing_messages.message: No messages were returned for this thread.

partial_bodies.message: Some comment text could not be read.

no_bodies.message: No comment text could be read.

unmatched_ranges_count.message: Threads with source positions but no message records: {count}.

partial_quotes.message: Some selected source text could not be read.

error_wrong_project.message: The original tab switched projects. Reopen the extension from the project you want to read.

error_sign_in.message: Your Overleaf session may have expired. Sign in again and reopen the extension from the project tab.

error_not_json.message: Overleaf did not return JSON. Check that you can open the Review panel in the original tab.

error_timeout.message: Overleaf took too long to return comments. Click Refresh comments to try again.

error_forbidden.message: This Overleaf session cannot read the project's comments (403).

error_read.message: Could not read comments. Check the original Overleaf tab and reopen the extension from it if needed.

error_thread_payload.message: Overleaf returned a comment list in an unrecognized format.

error_thread_records.message: Overleaf returned data with no recognizable threads. The comment count could not be verified.
